description: This file defines the User class within the OpenCart system, encapsulating user-related functionalities such as login, logout, permission checks, and user data management. It interacts with the database and session objects to authenticate users and manage user state.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A class representing the system user, handling authentication, permissions, and user info management within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the User object by loading user data from the session and database if a user is logged in.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, updating session and user data upon success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clearing session data and resetting user properties.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission key with a specified value.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Returns whether the user is currently logged in.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the username of the user.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Retrieves the first name of the user.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Retrieves the last name of the user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email address of the user.
